notes.title: A new demo update released!
notes.content:
Brutal next chapter of Amiga's legendary beat'em'up 'Franko: The Crazy Revenge' is here. 
Try a 2-player demo now! Are you ready? They are coming!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42826892/22b05a999170abe07524f93047591bfccaf0e3f8.png[/img]

Demo Version Features:
- play on a famous 'Rydla Street' level, packed with enemies, weapons and cringe taunts
- try both Skinny and Franko and see how they play
- learn the game in Tutorial mode
- hand drawn, old-school animations
- tons of humor and bad language in game
- play solo or in 2-player coop mode

- New sound effects
- New mid-boss music
- New Tutorial
